member.name: T:RedRat.RedRatHub.ConsoleLogOutput
member.summary:
We want certain startup information to always be printed on the console output regardless of logging levels. If we just use Console.WriteLine() then this won't appear in other log targets. If we just use logging, then it can be turned off.
So the application can adjust the console log level to temporarily print info log output, even if not generally enabled.

member.name: M:RedRat.RedRatHub.Controllers.RedRatsController.ResetNicAsync(System.String)
member.summary: Resets the network interface for the RedRat device if it is not accepting connections on the standard TCP port. This bypasses standard comms, so should work even if the RedRat device is not responding to normal commands. With an irNetBox-III, it will reset just the XPort. With the irNetBox-IV and RedRat-X, it uses a UDP message and causes a complete device reset.
member.param: The name, IP address or MAC address.
member.response: If the RedRat device is successfully reset.
If the RedRat device is not found.
With some other server error.
